rule_name: Must Be Accepted at an SEVP-Certified School
description: Must be accepted and enrolled at an SEVP-certified school, which issues the Form I-20 after entering the student in SEVIS. Non-SEVP schools cannot host F-1 students.
evidence_required: Form I-20 from an SEVP-certified school
condition: Accepted at a verified SEVP school
user_message_if_failed: Verify your school is SEVP-certified at studyinthestates.dhs.gov before paying any agent.

rule_name: Form I-20 Mandatory — Must Be Signed and Current
description: Form I-20 (Certificate of Eligibility) is mandatory, must be signed by the DSO and the student, and the school on it must match the visa for first entry. Details must be accurate and consistent.
evidence_required: Signed, current I-20 matching other documents
condition: Holds a valid, signed, consistent I-20
user_message_if_failed: No valid signed I-20 = no F-1 visa. Cross-check its details against your DS-160 and financials.

rule_name: SEVIS I-901 Fee Must Be Paid Before Visa Is Issued
description: The I-901 SEVIS fee (USD 350 for F-1; USD 220 for J-1) must be paid at fmjfee.com before the visa is issued, using the SEVIS ID on the I-20. Valid 12 months. F-2 dependants do not pay.
applies_to: All new F-1 students (new SEVIS ID)
evidence_required: I-901 receipt matching the I-20 SEVIS ID
condition: SEVIS fee paid and receipt matches I-20
user_message_if_failed: Pay the USD 350 SEVIS fee at fmjfee.com only. An unpaid/mismatched fee = refusal on the day with no same-day fix.

rule_name: DS-160 Online Application Must Be Completed and Consistent
description: The DS-160 must be completed online before the interview, with a printed barcode confirmation, and must be fully consistent with the I-20, financial documents, and academic/employment history.
user_message_if_failed: Complete the DS-160 carefully and make sure every answer matches your documents and what you'll say at interview.

rule_name: Social Media Must Be Public and Fully Disclosed (From June 18, 2025)
description: Since 18 Jun 2025, F/M/J applicants must set all social media profiles to public and disclose all handles used in the last 5 years on DS-160. No official pre-interview deadline; keep public until a decision is made. Omission is a ground for denial.
evidence_required: Public profiles; full handle disclosure on DS-160
condition: Profiles public and all handles disclosed
user_message_if_failed: Set all profiles to public and disclose every handle from the last 5 years. Omission can cause denial.

rule_name: Non-Immigrant Intent Must Be Demonstrated — Section 214(b)
description: INA 214(b) presumes every nonimmigrant applicant intends to immigrate; the applicant must overcome it by demonstrating strong ties to Pakistan and genuine, temporary student intent. #1 F-1 refusal ground for Pakistani applicants; officer-subjective and interview-driven.
evidence_required: Demonstrable home ties + credible, consistent study/return story
condition: Officer satisfied applicant will return home
user_message_if_failed: Build a specific, documentable return case (property, family business, career plan) and explain why USA/this university clearly. Weak ties = near-certain 214(b) refusal.

rule_name: Visa Interview at US Embassy/Consulate Required
description: A consular interview is generally required for applicants aged 14-79, with all core documents ready. 2025-2026 vetting may add 221(g) administrative processing.
evidence_required: Booked interview; passport, I-20, DS-160 confirmation, SEVIS receipt, financials
condition: Interview booked with all documents ready
user_message_if_failed: Book early and bring the full document set. Expect possible administrative processing under current vetting.

rule_name: Interview Readiness — Consistent, Genuine, Unscripted Answers
description: The applicant must give consistent, genuine, unscripted answers about study plan, university, finances/source of funds, and intent to return. Memorised agent scripts and inability to explain funding hurt credibility.
evidence_required: Practised but genuine answers; understanding of own finances
user_message_if_failed: Practise content, not scripts. Be able to explain your sponsor's income and your study/return plan in your own words.

rule_name: Financial Proof Must Cover Full Cost on the I-20
description: Must prove funds to cover the full first-year cost of attendance stated on the I-20 (tuition + living) plus travel, without unauthorized work. Funds must be genuine, traceable, and (ideally) backed by ~6 months of consistent statements and documented source of funds. The US sets no fixed living-cost figure.
evidence_required: Bank statements (6 months), sponsor income proof (salary/NTN/FBR), source-of-funds evidence
condition: Funds cover the I-20 total + travel, genuine and traceable
user_message_if_failed: Cover the full I-20 cost plus travel with traceable funds. Underfunding and unexplained deposits are top 214(b) refusal causes.

rule_name: Passport Must Be Valid 6+ Months Beyond Intended Stay
description: Passport must be valid at least 6 months beyond the intended period of stay.
user_message_if_failed: Renew your passport before applying if it doesn't have 6+ months beyond your intended stay.

rule_name: Cannot Enter the US More Than 30 Days Before Program Start
description: New/initial F-1 students cannot enter the US more than 30 days before the I-20 program start date.
user_message_if_failed: Do not travel more than 30 days before your I-20 start date — you will be denied entry.

description: F-1 students must maintain full-time enrolment throughout the program; dropping below without DSO approval terminates the SEVIS record.
evidence_required: Full-time enrolment; DSO approval for any reduction
user_message_if_failed: Stay full-time. A reduced course load without DSO approval ends your status.

rule_name: No Work Without Proper Authorization — Zero Tolerance
description: F-1 students may work only when specifically authorized (on-campus rules, CPT via DSO, OPT/STEM OPT via USCIS). Unauthorized work terminates status with zero tolerance.
user_message_if_failed: Never work without authorization — it permanently terminates F-1 status and risks deportation and bars.

rule_name: Prior Visa Refusals and Immigration Violations Must Be Disclosed
description: All prior visa refusals, overstays, removals, and asylum history must be disclosed truthfully on the DS-160. Non-disclosure is misrepresentation with a permanent-bar risk.
evidence_required: Truthful DS-160 disclosure; explanation of prior refusals
user_message_if_failed: Disclose every refusal/overstay/removal/asylum claim on DS-160. Concealment risks a permanent bar.

rule_name: F-2 Dependants Cannot Work Under Any Circumstances
description: F-2 dependants cannot work under any circumstances; each needs their own I-20 and F-2 visa. F-2s do not pay the SEVIS fee, but their costs add to required funds.
user_message_if_failed: F-2 dependants are absolutely barred from working; budget extra funds for them.

description: Education/employment history should be consistent and logically connected to the chosen program; 12+ month gaps and drastic field changes/downgrades must be justified, and academic records must be complete and verifiable.
applies_to: Applicants with gaps, field changes, or unverified academics
evidence_required: Attested transcripts/degrees, gap evidence, study-plan justification
condition: Education path consistent or any gap/switch evidenced
user_message_if_failed: Justify gaps and field switches with evidence; have complete, verifiable academic records.

description: The applicant is responsible for everything submitted in their name and said at interview, including by an agent. Fabricated documents or concealment advised by agents cause refusal and a permanent misrepresentation bar.
evidence_required: Personal verification of all documents and DS-160
condition: Verified all submissions; no fabricated documents
user_message_if_failed: Verify every document and DS-160 answer yourself. Agent-fabricated content or hidden facts make YOU liable for a permanent bar.
